contexts.text: The reason why life is described by inspiration and by breath is that the men of the Most Ancient Church perceived the states of love and faith through the states of the breathing.

That the breath is taken for the life of faith and of love is evident in Job; That spirit is in man, and the breath of Shaddai causeth them to understand (); and again, The Spirit of God made me, and the breath of Shaddai vivified me ().
Hence it is that the Lord is called the Spirit of the nostrils, and also the breath of life.
These three spheres are like atmospheres arising from the breathing-holes of the dragon.
